roadmap_payload.problem: A durable BLOCKED continuity artifact carried terminal_state.blocker fields that did not match its blocker_proof, so the released execution_continuity validator would reject the terminal boundary.
roadmap_payload.fix: Reinforce schema-typed checkpoint/finalization construction: derive all coupled BLOCKED terminal fields from one blocker_proof object and validate execution_continuity/Terminal-State v2 before persisting the artifact. Add a regression for code/evidence mismatch.
roadmap_payload.invariant: Durable terminal continuity is internally bound and validator-valid at commit time; free-form or independently copied blocker fields cannot be persisted as terminal evidence.
